title: Debounce Function
description: Limits the rate at which a function can fire.
explanation_md: Debouncing ensures that a function is not called too frequently. It waits for a specified period of inactivity before executing the function.

title: Deep Clone Object
description: Creates a deep copy of an object using structuredClone.
explanation_md: The `structuredClone()` method creates a deep copy of a given value using the structured clone algorithm.

title: Array Unique Values
explanation_md: Uses the `Set` object to store unique values and then spreads it back into an array.

title: Fetch with Timeout
description: Adds a timeout to a fetch request.
explanation_md: Uses `AbortController` to cancel a fetch request if it takes longer than the specified timeout.

title: Promisify Callback
description: Converts a callback-based function to return a promise.
explanation_md: Wraps a traditional callback-style function in a Promise constructor.
